```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
clean_data <- read_csv("/Users/chihhsuan/Desktop/UBC 26W/SOCI 502/SOCI502_data_story/data/clean_data.csv")
```

```{r}
glimpse(clean_data)
```

```{r}
head(clean_data)      
tail(clean_data)       
```

```{r}
table(clean_data$sex)
table(clean_data$age)
table(clean_data$edu)
table(clean_data$birth)
table(clean_data$country)
```

```{r}
# 哪些國家有缺失值
clean_data |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            n_missing = sum(is.na(unemp_rate))) |>
  filter(n_missing > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(n_missing))
```

```{r}
clean_data |>
  filter(sex == "female" & edu == "tertiary") |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            n_missing = sum(is.na(unemp_rate))) |>
  filter(n_missing > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(n_missing))
```

```{r}
#了解高等教育女性的缺失值發生在哪裡
clean_data |>
  filter(sex == "female", edu == "tertiary", is.na(unemp_rate)) |>
  arrange(country, birth, age) |>
  group_by(country, birth) |>
  summarise(missing_ages = paste(age, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

由以下的圖表可以看出：

盧森堡Luxembourg、挪威Norway、羅馬尼亞Romania三國在本地和外國都沒有資料；保加利亞Bulgaria、匈牙利Hungary、墨西哥Mexico、斯洛伐克Slovak Republic、斯洛維尼亞Slovenia、哥斯大黎加Costa Rica、波蘭Poland有本地資料但沒有外國資料。

```{r}
#把缺失最多的國家放前面
clean_data |>
  filter(sex == "female", edu == "tertiary", is.na(unemp_rate)) |>
  arrange(country, birth, age) |>
  group_by(country, birth) |>
  summarise(n_missing = n(),
            missing_ages = paste(age, collapse = ", "),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(country) |>
  mutate(missing_total = sum(n_missing)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(desc(missing_total), country, birth) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```
